state.request: TUI session UX and observability fixes for the agentum terminal app (crates/agentum-tui): 1) In-session agent management: from inside a session view, let the user add more agents (spawn a new plain terminal pane or another agent such as claude/codex) and add keyboard shortcuts to move focus between sessions/panes and to resize panes. 2) Keybind change: make C the key for create (change the current create/new-session keybind). 3) Error copy: improve error messages so the full error can be pasted into an LLM chat for debugging — include operation, session id, daemon/host state, version, and log file location where relevant. 4) Bug: the per-session/per-agent usage readout (bottom-left usage panel, /api/usage/claude) is not working, and agent tasks are not working either. 5) Bug: the Plan / Todos / Agents right-side panels (agent-tasks panel backed by transcript_store and /api/sessions/{id}/agent-tasks) are not working — investigate why and fix.

evidence.summary: TUI unit tests verify terminal-origin create uses Auxiliary destination, inherits profile/host/workdir, attaches a right pane, and preserves the original left session; the full workspace suite passes.
Unit coverage verifies target-host availability filtering and recoverable partial create/start failure diagnostics; strict workspace clippy and all tests pass.
Focus-cycle and observed-session tests cover Tree, left terminal, right terminal, and Lazygit in both directions, with surviving-pane focus behavior and passthrough guards.
Split-bound tests verify bounded ratios, no collapse, persistent preference updates, no-split messaging, and resizing of both stream dimensions.

Keybinding tests prove uppercase C is the sole create character, lowercase c remains separate, n is inactive, and terminal-focused input is forwarded. Real PTY opened the form with Shift-C from tree focus.
Diagnostic tests verify full structured copy reports, exact session/daemon/host/version/log fields, unknown labels, clear behavior, and redaction of bearer, OAuth, password, and hook-token shapes.
Usage tests cover immediate fetch, attempt-based retry cadence, stale last-good retention, in-flight clearing, explicit loading/source/error states, and copyable diagnostics.
Server usage tests cover generated/source metadata, not-installed/local-scan/live degradation, unreadable stores, and credential-safe OAuth handling.
Task snapshot tests cover first-selection fetch, event and focus refresh, plan/todo/task/subagent record parsing, and focused left/right session observation without cross-session state reuse.

Transcript-store and host-runtime tests cover UUID-pinned local and SSH paths, creation, partial append, missed append reconciliation, truncation, atomic replacement, remote clear/replace reset, read errors, and session isolation.
Snapshot/API/UI tests distinguish unsupported, waiting transcript, empty, stale, host unavailable, read error, and incompatible daemon while retaining last-good data on fetch failure.
cargo test --workspace passed across all crates and integration tests; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings also passed.
